Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert made a mistake by selecting the wrong citation reference link. The process described involved accessing the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston website directly via the URL provided in the conversation, rather than identifying the correct citation reference link from Carl Nebel's Wikipedia page. This oversight led to the wrong path being pursued, which caused subsequent errors in retrieving the correct image for analysis. The mistake was compounded when the code executed attempted to perform OCR on what appeared to be an unrelated logo image, as indicated by the Image URL (https://www.mfah.org/Content/Images/logo-print.png). Thus, the error stemmed from initially not verifying the correct reference link from the Wikipedia page's content, which misdirected following steps.
